content.rendered: Thank you to our fabulous Hawks View PAC and families for an amazing week full of surprises! You all went above and beyond, and we felt very spoiled and appreciated. For this weeks information, please follow the link: https://www.smore.com/czat2. Wishing you all a wonderful weekend!
